New Zealand Wins 5th T20I Against India, India Clinches Series 3-2

New Zealand secured a seven-wicket victory in the fifth and final T20 International against India. Tim Seifert scored 93 runs, and Glenn Phillips also contributed significantly, guiding New Zealand to the win. Despite this consolation victory, India had already secured the series 3-2. Earlier in the match, New Zealand's Milne took two wickets in successive overs, dismissing Abhishek Sharma and Sanju Samson during the powerplay, before Ishan Kishan and Shreyas Iyer built a 93-run partnership off 43 balls for India.
